responsibility: Declares the state-purging analysis used to simplify analyzer program_state objects. It defines state_purge_map plus the per-SSA-name and per-decl summaries that record at which function_point locations state must be retained, along with the dot annotator used by analyzer dump output to visualize needed-versus-purgable symbolic state on the supergraph.
same_name_distinction: Declares the data structures and interfaces for purge results, including state_purge_map, per-SSA/per-decl summaries, function_point hash traits, and the dot annotator, while state-purge.cc performs the traversal and propagation that populate and use them.
